title: Direct HLTV review checked all 10 no-external-line fixtures on 2026-10-24; no two-sided HLTV bookmaker prices were shown
detail: Each HLTV match page confirmed the team pair, event and schedule and listed Best of 3. Its fetched Betting section contained a Stake US sweepstake promotion rather than two-sided bookmaker decimal prices. HLTV fan votes were excluded. Original betting surfaces were then checked by the runner; only the reviewed collector can admit a valid order book. The picks remain independently originated and explicitly labelled when they use a research fallback. See data/research/89c00d8a/platform-source-review.json and line-source-research.json.

title: Four scheduled publisher runs stopped before collection on a date-bound test fixture; the test clock is now pinned
detail: Runs 40028653350, 40037957529, 40048429858 and 40063011446 failed in pre-collection regression tests when the real clock moved the fixed fixture beyond the 12-hour freshness guard. The three affected tests now pass their fixture time through the existing build_plan(now=...) parameter. Production freshness refusal remains unchanged. This explains the stale public window and is fixed rather than hidden.
